title: Source generator crashes when a member is declared in metadata
head: 9df83c38

claims.claim: The generator no longer throws when a [MessagePackObject] type inherits a member declared in a referenced assembly.
claims.why_this_tier: The new regression test fails on base with InvalidOperationException and passes on the branch.

chain.link: Test reproduces the crash on base
Same test passes on branch head

claims.claim: Generated formatters for every existing snapshot type are byte-identical before and after the change.
claims.why_this_tier: Regenerated all snapshot outputs on base and head; the byte diff is empty.

claims.claim: A new filter, ReportIfLocatedInCompilation, drops every diagnostic whose location is not in the compilation's own source.
claims.why_this_tier: It silences diagnostics, including ones that point at metadata members a user can still fix by changing their own attributes.

chain.link: Report sites that go through the filter (report-sites)
A probe diagnostic is lost on branch (dropped-warning)
No lost diagnostic is one a user needs

claims.claim: Skipping metadata members in the collector is safe because their formatters come from the referenced assembly.
claims.why_this_tier: No test covers a referenced assembly that ships without its own formatter.

claims.claim: Generator run time on the benchmark solution is within noise of base.
claims.why_this_tier: The number comes from a timing harness, not a pass/fail check.

found: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation also suppresses MsgPack003 for user types whose base class lives in a package.
The regression test pins one shape (inherited property); fields and explicit interface members are not exercised.
scope_drift: Analyser diagnostic filtering was not asked for by issue 2283.
not_checked: Diagnostics in IDE live analysis (only command-line build was run).
